description: Reads a LiveDoc at the requested revision and returns `{outline}` with each heading’s part ID, title, level, and nested heading path, without rendering body text. Use this to locate a section; call `read_document_section` for its content or `read_document_markdown` for the full document. Requires a project ID, space ID, and document name readable by the signed-in Polarion user.

document.description: LiveDoc name within the space, not a composite project/space/document path.

projectId.description: Polarion project ID that owns the LiveDoc, such as `PROJECT`.

revision.description: Repository revision to read; omit to use the current revision.

spaceId.description: Document space ID within the project, such as `Specifications`.

name: get_document_outline
title: Get LiveDoc outline
